Network Robustness Degradation Curves Plot Type

Source: R/stat_network_robustness.R
type_network_robustness.Rd

Generates publication-ready network stability and robustness curves comparing the degradation trajectory of different biological networks or cohorts.

Usage

type_network_robustness(
  show_se = TRUE,
  line_width = 1,
  point_size = 1.8,
  colors = c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00"),
  xlab = "Proportion of Nodes Removed",
  ylab = "Natural Connectivity"
)

Arguments

show_se

Logical. If TRUE, renders standard error ribbons for random attack simulations (default TRUE).

line_width

Line width for degradation curves (default 1.0).

point_size

Point size for sampled removal fractions (default 1.8).

colors

Vector of colors for condition groups. Default uses publication-ready palette.

xlab, ylab

Axis labels.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.
